shadows.name: row
shadows.purpose: Existing shadow-xs for white work rows.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Existing color-state transitions; no entrance choreography.

components.name: Selected navigation
components.description: Semantic current route in an inset pale rail.

components.name: Input
components.description: Preserved shadcn input vocabulary; no form behavior change.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;font:500 14px system-ui;color:oklch(.145 0 0)}.ds-field input{padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid oklch(.922 0 0);border-radius:calc(.625rem - 2px);font:400 14px system-ui;background:white;color:inherit}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:oklch(.556 0 0)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid oklch(.145 0 0);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Work row
components.description: Compact row with a distinct date and real record metadata.
components.css: .ds-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;background:white;border-radius:calc(.625rem + 4px);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.05);font:400 14px system-ui;color:oklch(.145 0 0)}.ds-date{padding-right:12px;border-right:1px solid oklch(.922 0 0);text-align:center;font-size:12px}.ds-date strong{font-size:18px}.ds-row p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:12px;color:oklch(.556 0 0)}

narrative.overview: Refine the operator-confirmed Obra/shadcn foundation. Preserve the neutral palette, existing logo and real behavior; improve hierarchy, density, accessibility and responsive composition.

rules.name: Truthful controls
rules.body: Do not present an unimplemented action as operational.

dos: Preserve real data and M2 semantics.
Verify narrow layouts and keyboard flow.
donts: Do not invent a business metric or event duration.
Do not treat the Agent dashboard as performer mobile.
